turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. I have about twenty-five minutes, and I'd like to know who decided on the zero.
Can I ask something off the record?
There's no off the record, Hale. I'm writing down everything that's said in here. Ask your question, then tell me who decided on the zero.
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.
I'm writing that down: "too busy to notice." My child doesn't lie, and you haven't shown me one document that says he did. Who decided on the zero?
